name: Amina Wadud
shortBio: African-American Islamic philosopher and scholar of Qur'anic hermeneutics who pioneered the "gender jihad" and tawhidic hermeneutical method, arguing that divine unity (tawhid) precludes patriarchal hierarchy among human moral agents.
centralQuestion: How does a holistic tawhidic hermeneutics of the Qur'an resolve historical tension between revelation's universal moral equality and patriarchal legal exegesis?

keyWorks.title: Qur'an and Woman: Rereading the Sacred Text from a Woman's Perspective
keyWorks.description: Seminal hermeneutical philosophy challenging atomistic male tafsir through contextual, linguistic, and moral-theological synthesis.

keyWorks.title: Inside the Gender Jihad: Women's Reform in Islam
keyWorks.description: Synthesizes tawhidic ethics with embodied justice praxis in global Muslim communities.
